pickup_points.title: Pickup points
pickup_points.description: Pickup points only store the items you ordered.

list.title: Cash on delivery
list.description: The goods are paid in cash directly to the courier, who delivers the order in Kyiv and nearby settlements: Brovary, Boryspil, Bucha, Vyshneve, Vyshgorod, Irpin, Chabany, Chayka and others.

list.title: Cash on delivery via Nova Poshta
list.description: Payment in cash upon receipt of the goods at a Nova Poshta branch (the cash on delivery fee will be included in the order price).

list.title: Bank transfer for individuals
list.description: We can accept payment to a current account – in this case there is no commission.

list.title: Credit / Debit card (Visa, MasterCard)
list.description: You can pay cashlessly using IBAN details or a bank card (key card), cards via a payment terminal (2% commission) or using Visa and Mastercard bank cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay when paying online on the website; with this payment method, the payment system commission is 1.3%.

list.title: Store pickup
list.description: You can pick up your order in one of our stores.

list.title: Pickup from Nova Poshta
list.description: The delivery cost is paid by the recipient, according to the tariffs of «Nova Poshta». Please note that on the 4th day of storage of the parcel at the branch, it will be returned to us. We also want to note that when choosing such delivery, a commission of 2% of the total order value will be taken into account.

list.title: Nova Poshta parcel locker pickup
list.description: The delivery cost is paid by the recipient according to Nova Poshta tariffs. Please note that on the 4th day of storage of the parcel at the branch, it will be returned.

list.title: Home delivery via Nova Poshta
list.description: Delivery is carried out by Nova Poshta throughout Ukraine. The delivery cost is paid by the recipient according to Nova Poshta tariffs.

list.title: «Up2date» - the next level in electronics and digital technology!
description: Among the many online platforms selling electronics, “Up2date” has long been known as a reliable online store where customers can purchase high-quality gadgets and electronics. Since starting our journey back in 2005, our company has continued to grow and expand year after year, offering products from trusted manufacturers. Today, 21 years later, we are proud to offer both our loyal and new customers one of the largest selections of gadgets and electronics in the country.

We work to bring modern and cutting-edge technology and accessories from leading global manufacturers to the Ukrainian market. If you want to be the first among your friends to get the latest smartphone, gaming console, or tablet, be sure to check out our online store!

list.title: Up2date store features
description: The website features a wide range of product categories where you can find accessories for iPad and iPhone, as well as e-readers, watches, headphones, audio equipment, photography gear, and much more. We also offer a large section dedicated to gaming consoles that passionate gamers will truly appreciate.
All categories are regularly updated with new models, so you can always purchase the latest gadgets. Registered customers receive special bonuses, making shopping in our store even more rewarding.

description.sub_title: Key advantages of the Up2date store that make customers choose us:
sub_list: Competitive prices, additional bonuses, and special promotional offers
Warranty on all products (from 6 to 36 months)
High-quality service that makes shopping with us fast and convenient
A wide product range that satisfies even the most demanding customers
Convenient payment methods, including both cash and cashless payments

description: For your convenience, you can search for products not only by categories but also by manufacturers listed in alphabetical order. If needed, our managers are always ready to provide professional консультации by phone and help you choose the best option based on your needs.

list.title: Our motto: Not a day without new arrivals!
description: We are pleased that our customers include not only residents of Ukraine but also customers from neighboring countries. Over 21 years of operation, it is difficult to count the total number of customers we have served, but one thing we can say with confidence: 9 out of 10 new buyers become our regular customers.

Our online store is updated with new products every day, allowing our customers to be among the first to get the latest gadgets and accessories. We value speed and efficiency, so we deliver orders as quickly as possible across the country and even to neighboring countries.
Shop high-quality products at affordable prices on our website! Make your life more comfortable and convenient with electronics from Up2date!

top.title: A new level in electronics and digital technology!
top.description_top: Welcome to Up2Date – the online store every gamer in Ukraine knows! For many years, we’ve been selling products connected to the gaming industry, from consoles of all models to accessories and audio equipment. Our gamer-focused store offers a huge selection of gadgets and products from leading global brands. Here, you’ll always find exactly what you’re looking for, whether for yourself or as a gift. We provide competitive prices and 100% authentic products.
top.description_bottom: Our gaming console store has been around for many years and has earned a strong reputation among Ukrainian gamers. We receive direct supplies from leading manufacturers and constantly update our catalogs. Today, you’ll find not only gaming-related products but also complementary devices and a variety of gadgets from popular brands. Nevertheless, we remain a dedicated gaming tech store and are among the first to bring the latest products to Ukraine.

bottom.description_top: In our electronics online store, you’ll find everything you need. We constantly update our catalogs and bring in the hottest new arrivals. We also haven’t forgotten about fans of classics and even retro – that’s why our catalogs include retro games, board games, retro consoles, and more. At Up2Date, you can shop the following product categories:
description_list: Various accessories (cases, cables, screen protectors, memory cards, etc.);
description_bottom: We supply only original products from leading manufacturers such as Sony, Nintendo, Microsoft, Hori, and others. Every product comes with a warranty card.

You can also purchase subscriptions to gaming services on the Up2Date website, including Steam, EA Pass, PlayStation Plus, Xbox Game Pass, and more. Vouchers for these subscriptions can be used personally or purchased as a gift for a gamer friend — it’s a present no one will refuse!

In addition to gaming-related products, we also offer other types of tech, such as electric transport, graphic tablets, crypto wallets, quadcopters, 3D pens, and various accessories. All of this can be purchased on Up2Date in just a few clicks.
